MODE.description: Operating mode. standalone serves the complete speed test in a single container.

TITLE.description: Title displayed on the speed test page.

TELEMETRY.description: Enable storing speed test results. Requires mounting a /database volume and setting EMAIL for GDPR compliance.

DISABLE_IPINFO.description: Disable ISP name and location display. Set to true for extra privacy.

DISTANCE.description: Unit for server distance display. Use km, mi, or leave empty to disable.
